title: Logs
description: Record the logs of Linux boards over SSH, any log file, or the output of any command.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: One entry for each log to record. Auto-configure adds this computer's system log on Linux, or the demo device to an empty list.

read.title: Read
read.description: System log reads the journal, or syslog where there is none, on Linux.

name.title: Name
name.description: How this source appears in the trace. Empty names it after where it reads, such as bench_local. Letters, digits, spaces, _ and -.

host.title: Host
host.description: [user@]host, or a Host from your SSH config.

ssh_port.title: SSH port
ssh_port.description: Empty uses your SSH config, or 22.

key_path.title: Key file
key_path.description: A private key to use instead of your SSH agent, your default keys and the key from Show Access Key.

host_key_policy.title: Host key check
host_key_policy.description: Trust any key keeps working after a board is reflashed. Check known_hosts refuses a key it does not know.

ssh_options.title: Extra ssh options
ssh_options.description: Added to the ssh command, such as -J bastion for a jump host.

history.title: History
history.description: On the first start, also record what was logged earlier this boot. That covers the journal and the kernel's lines dmesg prints, as far back as Zelos keeps data; a file starts at its new lines.

time_source.title: Time
time_source.description: The device's clock places rows by the uptime stamped on each line, so a wrong date still lines up. Lines with none use their arrival.

values.title: Printed values as signals
values.description: Records numbers a line prints, such as rpm=1450, as signals you can plot. Automatic leaves it off for the system log and the kernel's lines, which print settings, not measurements.

path.title: File
path.description: The file to follow, such as /var/log/app.log. Rotation keeps working.

command.title: Command
command.description: Any command that prints lines, such as dmesg -w or adb logcat. Over SSH it runs in sh on the host.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Every source shows under it, as in Logs/bench_1.

log_level.title: Extension log level
log_level.description: How much Logs reports about itself; it never filters the lines it records.
